headline: Gold.com, Inc. Appoints Nick Bowkett as Vice President of Trading and Business Development
summary: Gold.com, Inc. has appointed Nick Bowkett as its new Vice President of Trading and Business Development, effective November 2, 2026.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. Issues Total Voting Rights Notification
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has disclosed its total issued share capital and voting rights as of October 31, 2026, in compliance with regulatory requirements.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. announced its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting progress on its hub-and-spoke mining platform and a production target of 150,000 to 200,000 ounces of gold by 2028.

headline: Newmont Updates Full-Year 2026 Cost Guidance
summary: Newmont Corporation has updated its full-year 2026 gold by-product cost guidance, citing continued cost discipline and stronger co-product pricing.

headline: Gold.com, Inc. Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results
summary: Gold.com, Inc. announced its financial results for the fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting revenues of $3.265 billion and a quarterly cash dividend declaration.

headline: Gold Terra Resource Corp. Announces Initial Drill Results on Zone 103N
summary: Gold Terra Resource Corp. reported initial drill results from Zone 103N, a property subject to an option agreement with a subsidiary of Newmont Corporation.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
summary: AngloGold Ashanti announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting headline earnings per share of $1.55 and gold income of $2.56 billion.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Declares Fourth-Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. announced a cash dividend of $0.195 per common share for the fourth quarter of 2026, representing an 18% increase over the previous year's corresponding dividend.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. announced its financial and operational results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting adjusted earnings per share of $0.90.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Receives First Deliveries from Platreef Project
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals has received its first metal deliveries from the Platreef project, marking a milestone in its streaming portfolio.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Commences Environmental Baseline Studies for São Jorge Gold Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. has initiated environmental and socioeconomic baseline studies to support the permitting process for its São Jorge Gold Project in Brazil.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Advances Nevada Gold Projects
summary: AngloGold Ashanti is investing in the development of its Arthur Gold Project in Nevada, which includes the Silicon and Merlin deposits.

headline: Barrick Re-evaluates Fourmile Gold Deposit Plans Within Nevada Gold Mines Joint Venture
summary: Barrick Gold is re-evaluating engineering and access plans for the Fourmile gold deposit, impacting the timeline for its pre-feasibility study within the Nevada Gold Mines joint venture with Newmont.

headline: Processing Plant from Agnico Eagle's Hope Bay Project Delivered to Nova's Port MacKenzie Site
summary: A processing plant formerly owned and operated by Agnico Eagle at the Hope Bay Gold Project has been relocated to Nova's Port MacKenzie site.

headline: Analysts Revise Revenue Forecasts for Gold.com, Inc.
summary: Analysts covering Gold.com, Inc. have significantly lowered their revenue estimates for the company, citing a weaker outlook.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Awards $1 Billion Underground Mining Contract to Perenti at Geita Gold Mine
summary: AngloGold Ashanti has awarded a five-year, approximately A$1 billion (US$670 million) contract to Perenti's subsidiary, African Underground Mining Services (AUMS), to continue underground mining operations at the Geita gold mine in Tanzania.

headline: Agnico Eagle Outlines Strategic Growth Pathway for Canadian Malartic Complex
summary: Agnico Eagle has detailed a strategic plan to reach approximately 1.0 million ounces of annual gold production at the Canadian Malartic Complex by 2033.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Identified as Potential Financing Partner for Aris Mining's Toroparu Project
summary: Aris Mining's updated pre-feasibility study for the Toroparu gold project in Guyana highlights a potential $138 million streaming contribution from Wheaton Precious Metals.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Announces Strategic Investment in Sitka Gold Corp.
summary: AngloGold Ashanti is acquiring a 15% equity stake in Sitka Gold Corp. as part of a strategic investment to support the development of the RC Gold Project in the Yukon.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Commences Production Mining at Archimedes Underground Project
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. has officially started production mining at its Archimedes underground project in Nevada, marking the company's second underground mine to reach this stage.
